title: THE IMPACT OF TAURINE-CONTAINING DRUG ON OXIDATIVE STATUS IN OVARIECTOMIZED RATS WITH METABOLIC SYNDROME

sections.abstract: <jats:p>The affect of taurine-containing drug «Kratal» on oxidative status of ovariectomized rats withmetabolic syndrome, which have been fed high fat diet, is investigated. It has been established drugadministration per os suppresses development of oxidative stress. Given results are the base for further«Kratal» application for prophylaxis and cardiovascular pathologies treatment in postmenopausalwomen</jats:p>
